en.text: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.

zhSimplified.text: 我要为我所亲爱的唱歌， 是我所爱者的歌，论他葡萄园的事： 我所亲爱的有葡萄园在肥美的山冈上。

zhTraditional.text: 我要為我所親愛的唱歌， 是我所愛者的歌，論他葡萄園的事： 我所親愛的有葡萄園在肥美的山岡上。

en.text: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

zhSimplified.text: 他刨挖园子，捡去石头， 栽种上等的葡萄树， 在园中盖了一座楼， 又凿出压酒池； 指望结好葡萄， 反倒结了野葡萄。

zhTraditional.text: 他刨挖園子，撿去石頭， 栽種上等的葡萄樹， 在園中蓋了一座樓， 又鑿出壓酒池； 指望結好葡萄， 反倒結了野葡萄。

en.text: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

zhSimplified.text: 耶路撒冷的居民和犹大人哪， 请你们现今在我与我的葡萄园中，断定是非。

zhTraditional.text: 耶路撒冷的居民和猶大人哪， 請你們現今在我與我的葡萄園中，斷定是非。

en.text: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

zhSimplified.text: 我为我葡萄园所做之外， 还有什么可做的呢？ 我指望结好葡萄， 怎么倒结了野葡萄呢？

zhTraditional.text: 我為我葡萄園所做之外， 還有甚麼可做的呢？ 我指望結好葡萄， 怎麼倒結了野葡萄呢？

en.text: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.

zhSimplified.text: 现在我告诉你们， 我要向我葡萄园怎样行： 我必撤去篱笆，使它被吞灭， 拆毁墙垣，使它被践踏。

zhTraditional.text: 現在我告訴你們， 我要向我葡萄園怎樣行： 我必撤去籬笆，使它被吞滅， 拆毀牆垣，使它被踐踏。

en.text: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”

zhSimplified.text: 我必使它荒废，不再修理， 不再锄刨，荆棘蒺藜倒要生长。 我也必命云不降雨在其上。

zhTraditional.text: 我必使它荒廢，不再修理， 不再鋤刨，荊棘蒺藜倒要生長。 我也必命雲不降雨在其上。

en.text: For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.

zhSimplified.text: 万军之耶和华的葡萄园就是以色列家； 他所喜爱的树就是犹大人。 他指望的是公平， 谁知倒有暴虐； 指望的是公义， 谁知倒有冤声。

zhTraditional.text: 萬軍之耶和華的葡萄園就是以色列家； 他所喜愛的樹就是猶大人。 他指望的是公平， 誰知倒有暴虐； 指望的是公義， 誰知倒有冤聲。

en.text: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

zhSimplified.text: 祸哉！那些以房接房， 以地连地， 以致不留余地的， 只顾自己独居境内。

zhTraditional.text: 禍哉！那些以房接房， 以地連地， 以致不留餘地的， 只顧自己獨居境內。

en.text: In my ears, the LORD of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

zhSimplified.text: 我耳闻万军之耶和华说： 必有许多又大又美的房屋 成为荒凉，无人居住。

zhTraditional.text: 我耳聞萬軍之耶和華說： 必有許多又大又美的房屋 成為荒涼，無人居住。

en.text: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

footnotes.text: 5:10 literally, ten yokes, or the amount of land that ten yokes of oxen can plow in one day, which is about 10 acres or 4 hectares.
5:10 1 bath is about 22 liters or 5.8 U. S. gallons
5:10 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels
5:10 1 ephah is about 22 liters or 0.6 bushels or about 2 pecks—only one tenth of what was sown.

zhSimplified.text: 三十亩葡萄园只出一罢特酒； 一贺梅珥谷种只结一伊法粮食。

zhTraditional.text: 三十畝葡萄園只出一罷特酒； 一賀梅珥穀種只結一伊法糧食。

en.text: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!

zhSimplified.text: 祸哉！那些清早起来追求浓酒， 留连到夜深，甚至因酒发烧的人。

zhTraditional.text: 禍哉！那些清早起來追求濃酒， 留連到夜深，甚至因酒發燒的人。

en.text: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of the LORD, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在筵席上 弹琴，鼓瑟，击鼓，吹笛，饮酒， 却不顾念耶和华的作为， 也不留心他手所做的。

zhTraditional.text: 他們在筵席上 彈琴，鼓瑟，擊鼓，吹笛，飲酒， 卻不顧念耶和華的作為， 也不留心他手所做的。

en.text: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我的百姓因无知就被掳去； 他们的尊贵人甚是饥饿， 群众极其干渴。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我的百姓因無知就被擄去； 他們的尊貴人甚是飢餓， 群眾極其乾渴。

en.text: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.

footnotes.text: 5:14 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 故此，阴间扩张其欲， 开了无限量的口； 他们的荣耀、群众、繁华， 并快乐的人都落在其中。

zhTraditional.text: 故此，陰間擴張其欲， 開了無限量的口； 他們的榮耀、群眾、繁華， 並快樂的人都落在其中。

en.text: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;

zhSimplified.text: 卑贱人被压服； 尊贵人降为卑； 眼目高傲的人也降为卑。

zhTraditional.text: 卑賤人被壓服； 尊貴人降為卑； 眼目高傲的人也降為卑。

en.text: but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 惟有万军之耶和华因公平而崇高； 圣者 神因公义显为圣。

zhTraditional.text: 惟有萬軍之耶和華因公平而崇高； 聖者上帝因公義顯為聖。

en.text: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，羊羔必来吃草，如同在自己的草场； 丰肥人的荒场被游行的人吃尽。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，羊羔必來吃草，如同在自己的草場； 豐肥人的荒場被遊行的人吃盡。

en.text: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,

zhSimplified.text: 祸哉！那些以虚假之细绳牵罪孽的人！ 他们又像以套绳拉罪恶，

zhTraditional.text: 禍哉！那些以虛假之細繩牽罪孽的人！ 他們又像以套繩拉罪惡，

en.text: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”

zhSimplified.text: 说：任他急速行，赶快成就他的作为， 使我们看看； 任以色列圣者所谋划的临近成就， 使我们知道。

zhTraditional.text: 說：任他急速行，趕快成就他的作為， 使我們看看； 任以色列聖者所謀劃的臨近成就， 使我們知道。

en.text: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

zhSimplified.text: 祸哉！那些称恶为善，称善为恶， 以暗为光，以光为暗， 以苦为甜，以甜为苦的人。

zhTraditional.text: 禍哉！那些稱惡為善，稱善為惡， 以暗為光，以光為暗， 以苦為甜，以甜為苦的人。

en.text: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

zhSimplified.text: 祸哉！那些自以为有智慧， 自看为通达的人。

zhTraditional.text: 禍哉！那些自以為有智慧， 自看為通達的人。

en.text: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;

zhSimplified.text: 祸哉！那些勇于饮酒， 以能力调浓酒的人。

zhTraditional.text: 禍哉！那些勇於飲酒， 以能力調濃酒的人。

en.text: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!

zhSimplified.text: 他们因受贿赂，就称恶人为义， 将义人的义夺去。

zhTraditional.text: 他們因受賄賂，就稱惡人為義， 將義人的義奪去。

en.text: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of the LORD of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 火苗怎样吞灭碎秸， 干草怎样落在火焰之中， 照样，他们的根必像朽物， 他们的花必像灰尘飞腾； 因为他们厌弃万军之耶和华的训诲， 藐视以色列圣者的言语。

zhTraditional.text: 火苗怎樣吞滅碎稭， 乾草怎樣落在火焰之中， 照樣，他們的根必像朽物， 他們的花必像灰塵飛騰； 因為他們厭棄萬軍之耶和華的訓誨， 藐視以色列聖者的言語。

en.text: Therefore the LORD’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，耶和华的怒气向他的百姓发作。 他的手伸出攻击他们，山岭就震动； 他们的尸首在街市上好像粪土。 虽然如此，他的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，耶和華的怒氣向他的百姓發作。 他的手伸出攻擊他們，山嶺就震動； 他們的屍首在街市上好像糞土。 雖然如此，他的怒氣還未轉消； 他的手仍伸不縮。

en.text: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.

zhSimplified.text: 他必竖立大旗，招远方的国民， 发嘶声叫他们从地极而来； 看哪，他们必急速奔来。

zhTraditional.text: 他必豎立大旗，招遠方的國民， 發嘶聲叫他們從地極而來； 看哪，他們必急速奔來。

en.text: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,

zhSimplified.text: 其中没有疲倦的，绊跌的； 没有打盹的，睡觉的； 腰带并不放松， 鞋带也不折断。

zhTraditional.text: 其中沒有疲倦的，絆跌的； 沒有打盹的，睡覺的； 腰帶並不放鬆， 鞋帶也不折斷。

en.text: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.

zhSimplified.text: 他们的箭快利， 弓也上了弦。 马蹄算如坚石， 车轮好像旋风。

zhTraditional.text: 他們的箭快利， 弓也上了弦。 馬蹄算如堅石， 車輪好像旋風。

en.text: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.

zhSimplified.text: 他们要吼叫，像母狮子， 咆哮，像少壮狮子； 他们要咆哮抓食， 坦然叼去，无人救回。

zhTraditional.text: 他們要吼叫，像母獅子， 咆哮，像少壯獅子； 他們要咆哮抓食， 坦然叼去，無人救回。

en.text: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.

zhSimplified.text: 那日，他们要向以色列人吼叫， 像海浪匉訇； 人若望地，只见黑暗艰难， 光明在云中变为昏暗。

zhTraditional.text: 那日，他們要向以色列人吼叫， 像海浪匉訇； 人若望地，只見黑暗艱難， 光明在雲中變為昏暗。
